headline: FLEET HYGIENE DONE, LOOP CLEAN (2026-09-16): 20 PRs merged overnight and 0 left open. The session board is now a HARD RULE in CLAUDE.md §0 — claim your subsystem before you touch anything — which fit only after the 25KB steering budget went from 13 bytes spare to 133. Branch graveyard pruned 170 -> 76 (94 deleted, each verified byte-identical to its merged PR head; Adrian ran it, the agent credential 403s on ref deletion). New check-branch-ancestry gate catches squash-orphaned branches at commit time and caught its own merge within a minute. lilac finally has a main branch — it had none, plus nine mutually disjoint root histories. THE FUNNEL STILL READS 0 CONTACTED: that is the computed break, none of this moved it, and phone is the only live channel (1 lead of 263 has an email address).
